AO No. 591of2017 
With 
CLMA No. 13926 of 2017 
Hon’ble Lok Pal Singh, J.
Mr. Prabhat Pande, Advocate for the 
appellant. 
Present appeal is preferred against 
the judgment and award dated 
21.07.2017 passed by Motor Accident 
Claim Tribunal/District Judge, Pauri 
Garhwal, MAC case no. 25 of 2016. 
There is 9 days’ delay in filing the 
appeal. Grounds for delay are that the 
after obtaining certified copy of the 
impugned judgment legal opinion was 
sought for, and after approval the appeal 
has immediately been filed. 
No fruitful purpose would be served 
to issue notice to the respondent against 
delay condonation application, as much 
as, delay of 9 days’ is not too much. The 
delay is not inordinate and has 
sufficiently been explained. 
Delay of 9 days’ in filing the appeal 
is condoned. Delay condonation 
application is allowed. 
Admit the appeal. 
Summon the lower court record. 
Issue notice to the respondents. 
List for hearing on interim relief 
application after lower court record is 
received. 
 
 (Lok Pal Singh, J.) 
Parul 09.11.2017

orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Justice V. K. Bist
orders.text:
CLMA No. 13927/2017 (Stay Application) 
CLMA No. 1581/2018 (Money Withdrawal Application) 
In 
AO No. 591 of 2017 
Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J. 
Mr. Prabhat Pande, Advocate for the 
appellant. 
Mr. Vinodanand Barthwal, Advocate 
for respondent nos. 1 & 2. 
This is an Appeal from Order which 
has been preferred by the Insurance 
Company against the award dated 21.7.2017 
as rendered in MACP Case No. 25/2016. On 
the Appeal being preferred, this court while 
condoning the delay of 9 days and admitting 
the Appeal vide its order dated 09.11.2017 
had not passed any interim order staying the 
effect and operation of the award in favour 
of the appellant. 
Today, the matter is being listed on 
money withdrawal application as has been 
preferred by the respondent on account of 
the fact that since this court has never 
directed the appellant to deposit any amount 
as awarded in favour of the respondent 
claiming that there is no occasion for the 
respondent to file money withdrawal 
application because the claimant has remedy 
under law to file an execution proceeding 
for executing the award as rendered by the 
Motor Accident Claim Tribunal. 
Accordingly, the money withdrawal 
application stands rejected. 
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.) 16.02.2018 
Pooja

Mr. T.C. Pande, Advocate, holding brief of 
Mr. Prabhat Pande, Advocate for the appellant.
Mr. Vinoda Nand Barthwal, Advocate for the 
respondents.
The appellant has filed an urgency 
application, on the ground that in the absence of 
there being any interim order passed by this Court, 
the execution is being proceeded, though he has 
deposited the decreetal amount, before the court 
below under protest.
In view of the aforesaid statement made at 
the bar, the Urgency Application No.13928 of 2022 
would stand allowed. 
The appeal from order is directed to be listed 
under the head of hearing in the last week of July 
2022.
Since it is stated at bar, that the deposit has 
already been made by the appellant before the 
Motor Accident Claim Tribunal, no coercive 
measures as a consequence of execution 
proceedings, would be taken against the appellant 
till the next date of listing. 
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.) 08.06.2022

Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Prabhat Pande, Advocate, for the 
appellant. 
Mr. Vinodanand Barthwal, Advocate, for 
the respondent.
To the question raised by the learned 
counsel for the appellant pertaining to the 
maintainability of the claim petition under 
Section 166 of the Motor Vehicle Act.
Learned counsel for the respondent 
claimants submits that in the absence of there 
being a prior plea which was to be raised before 
the learned Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, 
the issue would be barred by principles of 
estoppels and the resjudicata.
In order to substantiate his argument, he 
wants to make reference to some judgments, for 
which he prays that he may be granted a week 
time.
The prayer sought for is granted.
The appeal from order is directed to be 
listed under the same head in the week 
commencing 05.09.2022.
(Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
